verdicts.reason: The Raw Water Screen Channel sends the Rake Torque Snapshot, and the Maintenance Planner uses “the snapshot” to compare planned rake work with mechanical loading.
South Filter Gallery sends the Filter Run Exception Note, which the Chief Operator uses to determine whether follow-up is needed.
The Coagulant Dosing Skid sends the Alum Batch Ticket, and the Laboratory Technician uses it to verify the chemical lot identity.
The Laboratory Technician sends the Sample Chain Slip, and the SCADA Historian Server uses it to associate water-quality entries with an operating period.

The Clearwell Level Controller sends the Clearwell Diver Entry Permit after level and isolation checks, and the Maintenance Planner uses “the permit” to verify isolation boundaries for confined-space work.
The Chief Operator produces the Backwash Solids Manifest, and the Residuals Hauler uses it to confirm load identity, destination, and acceptance requirements.
The Distribution Dispatcher sends the Pressure Zone Handoff Card, and the South Distribution Pressure Station uses “the card” to confirm zone status and related checks.
The Chemical Supplier Driver sends the Chlorine Cylinder Seal Log, which the Duty Engineer reviews before accepting a change in chlorine storage status.
The High Service Pump Header produces the Pump Bearing Vibration Clip, and the Maintenance Planner uses “the clip” to compare pump condition with inspection plans.
The document identifies Ironwood as the local name for the River Intake Pump Station, and the link uses that name for the station.
The document identifies Lantern as the local name for the SCADA Historian Server, and the link uses Lantern for that server.
The document identifies Marigold as the local name for the Coagulant Dosing Skid, and the link uses Marigold for that skid.
